_note: Per-repo inputs for the SV Way compliance checker (canonical copy: Stadium-Ventures/sv-registry scripts/compliance/sv-way-check.cjs). Authored 2026-07-29 (WP1 role-declaration pass); values established by reading this repo's files, not inference.
_roles_why: Per CLAUDE.md and sv-app.json: a static single-page tracker (index.html fetches data.csv client-side; no framework, no build, no crons). data.csv is a hand-maintained snapshot of MLB draft signings 2018-2026 (~5,500 rows) that exists nowhere else in the SV ecosystem — this repo is its home. The 2026 rows were seeded from the MLB Stats API draft feed joined with sv-draft-day's composite.json and are refreshed by a manual re-pull/re-merge (per sv-app.json runbook). The page, CSV export, and make-pdf.js PDF output are surface artifacts.

upstream.mechanism: Industry-wide draft-signing data from the MLB Stats API draft feed + agency mapping from Stadium-Ventures/sv-draft-day public/data/composite.json (manual re-pull/re-merge, no script). Not sourced from sv-registry.

_open_questions: data.csv is edited by hand and committed directly — no governed writer/write door exists.
The source/export behind the 2018-2025 historical rows is undocumented in-repo (per sv-app.json notes); refreshing them would require re-deriving that pull.
Player names here are industry-wide draft data, not SV client facts specifically; whether any rows about SV clients require resolution against sv-registry canon (read duty) is unassessed.
